displayName: OCI-AI-DB-033: AI — Data Pipeline Injection Attack
description:
Detects injection attacks targeting AI data pipelines that feed training or inference data

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_033", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%data%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%pipeline%') AND "value" > 0
